88 2 42
Whereas, it has been decided to delineate Area
89 0 68
of Operation of Water Users Association (WUA’s)
90 0 38
on hydraulic basis and as per Administrative
91 0 38
convenience under Sections 5, 6, 7 and Rule 3 of
92 0 56
the MMISF Act, 2005. I, S. S. Sonule, the Executive
Engineer, Baghltiadoh Irrigation Division, Gondia 93 0 32
hereby delineate Areas of operation of following 94 0 38
WUA’s and direct that the certified copy of 95 0 96
the updated map and list of land holders and/or
96 5 90
occupiers of said WUA’s shall be displayed on the
97 0 50
notice board of the offices of concerned Gram
98/1 0 60
Panchayat, Tahsil Office, Irrigation Section, Sub
98/2 0 73
Division and Division and at other prominent public
99/1B 0 41
Now therefore, I S. S. Sonule, the Executive En-
99/1C 0 41
gineer, Baghltiadoh Irrigation Division, Gondia also
hereby declare that no water shall be supplied by 99/2A 0 38
the Appropriate Authority to an individual holder or 99/2B 0 20
occupier of such land and that system of supply of 99/2C 0 62
water through Water User’s Association shall be bind-
101 0 22
ing on all the holders and occupiers of the said land
102 0 18
under Management of Irrigation System by Farmers.
100 0 18
Any person affected by this notification or part
103 0 30
thereof may within thirty days from the date of
104 0 16
publication of this notification in the Official
278 2 63
Gazette, file an appeal before Superintending
279 0 89
Engineer, Bhandara Irrigation Circle, Bhandara.

Bagh Itiadoh Division, Gondia also hereby declare that

to an individual holder or occupier of such land and
that system of supply of water through Water User
Association shall be binding on all the holders and
occupiers of the land under Management of Irrigation
System by Farmers.
Any person affected by this notification or part there of,
may within thirty days from the date of publication of this
notification in the Official Gazette, file an appeal before
Superintending Engineer, Bhandara Irrigation Circle
Bhandara.

Areas of Operation of following WUAs and direct that the

Therefore, I, S. S. Sonule, Executive Engineer, Bagh

no water should be supplied by the Appropriate Authority

system of supply of water through Water User’s Asso-
ciation shall be binding on all the holders and occupiers
of the said land under Management of Irrigation System
by Farmers.
Any person affected by this notification or part thereof,
may within 30 days from the date of publication of this
notification in the Official Gazette, file an appeal before
Superintending Engineer, Bhandara Irrigation Circle,
Bhandara.

BY EXECUTIVE ENGINEER
MMISF ACT, 2005.
Notification-III
No.236–Admin -4–IM–WUA–2020.—
Whereas, it has been decided to delineate the Area of Op-
eration of Water User’s Association (WUA’s) on hydraulic
basis and as per administrative convenience under Section 5,
6, 7 and Rule 3 of the MMISF Act, 2005. I, R. P. Varhade,
Executive Engineer, Lower Wardha Project Division, Wardha
hereby, delineate Areas of operation of following WUAs and
direct that the certified copy of the updated map and list of
land holders and/or occupiers of said WUAs shall be dis-
played on the notice board of the offices of concerned Gram
Panchayat, Tahsil Office, Irrigation Section, Sub-Division and
Division and at other prominent public places ;
Now, therefore I, R. P. Varhade, Executive Engineer, Lower
Wardha Project Division, Wardha also hereby, declare that no
water should be supplied by the Appropriate Authority to an
individual holder or occupiers of such land and the system of
supply of water through Water User’s Association shall be
binding on all the holders and occupiers of land under Man-
agement of Irrigation System by Farmers.
Any person affected by this notification or part there of,
may, within 30 days from the date of publication of this
notification in the Official Gazette, file an appeal before
Superintending Engineer, Nagpur Irrigation Circle, Nagpur.

Irrigation Scheme.

Water User Association–Pargothan Taluka Arvi, District
Wardha.
